rationale: This is a pure leg-swap that welds the validated distortion leg of "Accounting Conservatism Intensity" onto the cash-profitability leg of "Off Books Capital Formation" with no new economic content, and the switch also silently halves coverage (0.14 → ~0.084), so any alpha change is confounded with the post-1988 cash-flow-statement sample rather than with cash-versus-accrual validation.

This is a one-operator denominator tweak to an already-strong archived signal rather than a new mechanism, and the proposed fix does not deliver what it claims — ABS(oibdp)+dp assigns identical scale to firms with EBITDA of +100 and −100, so the ratio remains economically uninterpretable for loss-makers and merely trades one pathology for another.

target_name: Off Books Share Of Capital Formation
rationale: Rescaling net off-books formation by the firm's own total investment (dp + expensed outlay) rather than assets is a substantive, well-motivated attempt to strip out the R&D-intensity level effect and isolate the composition-of-investment claim, with a strictly positive denominator and a clear falsification criterion.

Adding expensed intangible outlays back to operating cash flow is the economically correct fix for the theme's internal inconsistency (validating with profitability measured after the very spending being argued to be investment) and is not reachable by rescaling any archived signal, though the reviewer should watch that xrd+xad now enters both legs, mechanically tilting the product toward squared R&D intensity.

The diagnostic intent is legitimate and the archive genuinely cannot separate cash validation from sample period, but as constructed the test changes the validator and the sample simultaneously (coverage jumps 0.084 → ~0.14), so it will not cleanly answer the question unless the accrual version is also evaluated on the oancf-available subsample.

Gross-margin stability is a defensibly different construct from the bottom-line profitability volatility that failed in generation 1, since it isolates pricing power from leverage and tax noise, but the three-leg MIN-plus-product structure dilutes each component and the double coverage hit from oancf plus a five-year history window risks a sparse, unstable long leg.
